source.author: verg
source.text: Obvertunt pelago proras; tum dente tenaci ancora fundabat naves, et litora curvae praetexunt puppes.
source.text_original: Obvertunt pelago proras; tum dente tenaci / ancora fundabat naves, et litora curvae / praetexunt puppes.
source.text_english: They turn the prows toward the sea; then with its gripping tooth the anchor held the ships fast, and the curved sterns lined the shore.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sparguntur litore curvo lumina nondum ullis terras monstrantia nautis.
reuse.text_original: sparguntur litore curvo / lumina nondum ullis terras monstrantia nautis.
reuse.text_english: Lights are scattered along the curved shore, not yet showing the lands to any sailors.
